# Action Global News

> Independent news for operators on AI and AI search, business, markets, small business, global ecommerce, health and Colorado. Headquartered in Denver, Colorado. Original reporting with cited sources; live headline modules link to original publishers.

Publisher: Action Global News, 1001 Bannock St #660, Denver, CO 80204. Phone 1-800-481-8638.
Disclosure: articles about companies that share ownership with the publisher are labeled "From our network"; articles about clients of the publisher's agency are labeled "Sponsored".

## Articles
- [The White House renamed AI “Super Intelligence.” Here is what actually changes for business](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/super-intelligence-executive-order-business/): A terminology order, a federal definition still to come, and a voluntary accord signed by the biggest model builders. The practical footprint is narrower than the headlines, but it is not zero.
- [More than one in four U.S. workers now fear technology will make their job obsolete](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/gallup-tech-job-fears-2026/): Gallup’s latest reading is a record, and the worry has moved into groups that used to feel insulated. For employers, the anxiety is now a management problem whether or not the layoffs ever arrive.
- [AI shopping agents can now complete the purchase. Most small stores are not ready to be chosen](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/agentic-commerce-small-retailers/): Checkout inside a chat window has been live for a year, and payment platforms have quietly switched agent support on for millions of merchants. The new problem is not access. It is whether an agent can read your store we
- [Monitored wildlife populations are down 73% since 1970. This year’s report leans on the recoveries](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/living-planet-report-2026-wildlife-decline/): The headline figure matches the last edition, now extended to 2022. The emphasis has shifted: WWF wants readers to see that targeted conservation is working, and that energy, food and finance decide the rest.
- [WHO’s first global rules for treating childhood obesity put lifestyle first and limit drugs to teens](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/who-child-adolescent-obesity-guidelines/): About 170 million children and adolescents were living with obesity in 2024. The new guidance treats obesity as a chronic disease, leads with structured lifestyle programs, and draws a firm line on medicines for younger children.
- [The chemistry Nobel goes to the scientists who showed how molecules pick a side](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/nobel-chemistry-2026-kagan-soai-mirror-molecules/): Many molecules come in left- and right-handed forms, and life uses only one. Two chemists, working a decade apart, showed how a tiny imbalance between those forms can be amplified, work now used in designing reactions for drug manufacturing.
- [Samsung’s quarterly profit just topped 100 trillion won. The AI memory boom paid for it](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/samsung-record-q3-profit-ai-memory/): Preliminary figures show operating profit up 783% from a year earlier on surging demand for the memory that AI data centers run on. The same price spike is quietly raising costs elsewhere.
- [Free AI agents are everywhere now. When does a business need one built to fit?](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/custom-ai-agents-small-business/): The platforms are giving away general-purpose agents. The work that actually saves a small business time usually lives in the gaps between its own systems, and that is where custom builds earn their keep.
- [Meta just handed small businesses a free AI agent. Here is what Muse can touch, and what it cannot](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/meta-muse-small-business-ai-agent/): Muse for Small Business connects to the tools owners already use and drafts the plans, campaigns and emails they never have time for. The free tier is the headline. The permissions are the story.
- [The FTC is investigating rogue AI agents. Businesses deploying them should read the subtext](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/ftc-probe-rogue-ai-agents/): The first U.S. regulatory action aimed squarely at autonomous AI agents targets the labs that build them. The theory behind it, that people and companies answer for what their software does, reaches much further.
- [The data center backlash has found its issue: the electricity bill](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/data-center-backlash-electricity-bills/): Local fights over hyperscale facilities used to be about noise and land. Now they are about household power costs, and the opposition no longer sorts neatly by party.
- [SBA disaster loans, explained for small business owners who have never needed one](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/sba-disaster-loans-small-business-guide/): After a declared disaster, the federal government’s largest source of recovery money for businesses is a loan, not a grant. Here is how it works, what it covers and why waiting for the insurance check is the most common 
- [AI search optimization: how a small business gets named inside the answer](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/ai-search-optimization-small-business/): Search used to send people to a list of links. Increasingly it hands them a finished answer. For local and small businesses, the job has shifted from ranking on a page to being one of the few names an AI system is willin
- [Rent, buy or subscribe to own: the real cost of a small business website](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/subscribe-to-own-website-model/): The sticker price of a website tells you very little. What matters is what you pay over the life of the site, what you own at the end of it, and who is accountable when it does not perform.
- [Bathroom remodeling for elderly parents: the aging-in-place decisions that matter most](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/bathroom-remodel-for-elderly-parents/): Searches for senior bathroom remodels have jumped this year, and for good reason. The bathroom is where small design decisions have the largest effect on whether someone can keep living at home.
- [Losing weight on a GLP-1? The muscle you keep matters as much as the pounds you lose](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/glp1-muscle-loss-protein-strength/): The newest weight-loss medications work. The body-composition data from their trials also shows a cost that is easy to miss on a bathroom scale, and the research on how to limit it is getting clearer.
- [A press release written for the machines that now decide who gets quoted](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/machine-readable-press-releases/): Traditional wires sell reach to newsrooms. A newer kind of wire sells something narrower and, for small companies, often more useful: a permanent, dated, attributed record that search engines and AI systems can read with
- [A free national business directory built on open map data, not scraped listings](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/usabusinesssearch-free-business-directory/): Most directories either scrape other directories or charge businesses to exist. USABusinessSearch.com starts from open map data, lists businesses free, and lets owners claim and correct their own records.
- [The world’s first walk-in VR shopping mall opens its doors](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/world-vr-mall-launch/): World VR Mall lets shoppers walk a three-dimensional concourse and step into storefronts that route through to live ecommerce sites.
- [A browser-based flight simulator aimed at student pilots launches without a download](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/vr-flight-simulator-launch/): No install, no headset, no client. The pitch is procedural familiarity before you start paying for airtime.
- [Conversational AI has quietly become table stakes for small business websites](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/conversational-ai-small-business/): The demos are easy and the deployments are not. What separates an assistant that earns its place from one that gets switched off.
- [The press release didn’t die. It got rebuilt for machines that read](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/press-release-ai-search/): Wire distribution collapsed as an SEO tactic. The format underneath suits machine retrieval almost perfectly.
- [The quiet distribution channel: what happens inside local buy-sell groups](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/local-groups-distribution/): Community commerce networks move real volume and almost nobody measures them properly.
- [Marketing inside the most scrutinized category in medicine](https://actionglobalnews.com/articles/glp1-telehealth-marketing/): What a compliant acquisition strategy looks like when most of the usual channels say no by default.
